nodes.long_description:
Involve XR offers unparalleled flexibility and customization without the need for code, and integrates into enterprise data and learning management systems.

The platform operates as both a multi-user synchronous training and assessment tool, and an asynchronous learning and practice platform, deployable in both training centers and directly to remote workers at home or in the field with low cost hardware, or via flat screens.
nodes.short_description: Involve XR is an open and flexible learning & assessment platform for institutions looking to deploy data-driven, enterprise-grade, immersive training and assessment across healthcare and public safety sectors.

***Maintenance Update:***
---
•	NPC Response fix, and stability improvements 
---
•	Phone NPC: Added a configurable Phone NPC that can be added to Learning Experiences.



***New Features:***
---
•	Phone NPC: Added a configurable Phone NPC that can be added to Learning Experiences.
---
•	New Patient Conditions: Added capillary refill and erythema for all patients, with educator-configurable refill times.
---
•	Patient Date of Birth: Patients now include a date of birth with automatic age calculation.
---
•	Ventilator Updates: Added Compliance and Resistance to patient states, with ventilator waveforms updating accordingly.
---
•	Create Sessions from Learning Experiences: Sessions can now be created directly from a Learning Experience.
---
•	Lithuanian Language Support: Added Lithuanian as a supported language.
---
•	New Voices: Added six new ElevenLabs voices, including Irish, Slavic, and Eastern European accents.


***Improvements:***
---
•	AI Conversations: Upgraded the conversational AI backend to ChatGPT 5.4.
---
•	OnScreen: Improved the OnScreen experience with updated session controls, a speaking indicator, vitals monitor hover magnification, and back auscultation for seated patients.
---
•	OnScreen Web: Added a new UI layout, microphone guide and testing, in-session microphone switching, internet speed checks, and improved performance in high-latency environments.
---
•	Organizations: Invited users can now be added directly to a cohort.
---
•	Admin Portal: Added Non-Patient configuration support and updated the Learning Experience page.
---
•	Reporting: Checklist descriptions are now visible to SDLs.



***Bug Fixes:***

•	SDL session reports are now automatically sent to learners after VR and OnScreen sessions.
---
•	Corrected existing patient date of birth data.
---
•	Resolved OnScreen display issues with backboards and whiteboards.
---
•	Removed the Quit button from the Exit Session menu.
---
•	Resolved a broad set of user experience issues.

***New Features:***
---
•	OnScreen Web via Pixel Streaming: Learners can now access OnScreen simulations directly from a browser with no installation required. Access is provided via a link, with no download or setup. This feature will be rolled out progressively based on infrastructure readiness.
---
•	Cough for All Patients: Cough is now available as a triggerable condition for all patients. It can be activated via the Instructor App or pre-configured using a stage token. Supports single and multi-cough animations across multiple patient positions, and is appropriately blocked by unconscious states and non-pulsatile rhythms.
---
•	New Non-Patient Clothing: New clothing options for Non-Patient characters have been created. Assets are complete and will be integrated in a future release.



***Improvements:***
---
•	IV Pump: VR Improvements: Improved IV Pump experience in VR, including calculation fixes, interaction stability, and UI polish. The OnScreen version will follow in Release 17.0.
---
•	Radial Menu usability improvements
---
•	EMR Tablet readability improvements in OnScreen mode
---
•	Improved session duration tracking accuracy in Cognitive3D (ASPC)



***Known Issues and Limitations:***
---
•	Instructor App: Installation process may be complex for non-technical users and takes a bit more time now.
---
•	Performance: Unreal Engine 5 is more resource-intensive on Quest 2, and in some scenarios, this may impact frame rate. Ongoing optimizations are in progress to improve performance.
